slug: 2023-10-07 Centrafrique - la delivrance de la carte nationale d'identite facilitee pour les habitants de Bossangoa

systems.platform: photograph, fingerprint and signature captured locally; cards printed in Bangui
systems.owner: Al-Madina, the company producing the card
systems.tiers: ten-day enrolment campaign at the Bossangoa police station (Ouham), October 2023; 2,500 applicants targeted

note: An identity-card enrolment campaign; nothing on civil registration.
